title: Corrected speed and distance settings
description: The settings object of the built-in maths module esses.corrected_speed_distance, version 1 (03_MATHS_ENGINE.md section 9.1, D-016): project.json builtinMaths["esses.corrected_speed_distance"].settings and the settings of a builtin item in a sidecar's localMaths. It is a member of those documents, not a document, so it carries no $schema or schemaVersion. Every member is optional and an absent member takes the module default; quantities are {v, unit} with a unit of the units-1 table, converted to base units on load.

method.description: How Corr Speed is formed: the faster of two wheel speeds, the first available channel of a list, or wheel speed corrected by longitudinal acceleration (gCorrection, M3).

channels.description: The two wheel-speed channels; a missing one falls back to alternateList (W-CSD-FALLBACK).
Candidate speed channels in order; the first one the layer has is used as-is.

source.description: integrate: the cumulative integral of Corr Speed; logged: the unwrapped logged lap distance.

csdChannelName.description: A channel name as the layer spells it (looked up case-insensitively).
